page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine built on KVM virtualization and powered by an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor operating at 2.7 GHz. The system provides 32 vCPUs mapped across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading, alongside 128 GB of main memory. This maintains a standard balanced ratio of 4 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware features include support for advanced vector extensions such as AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, and AVX512_BF16, in addition to dedicated cryptographic acceleration instruction sets including AES, VAES, and SHA-NI. The instance relies entirely on remote storage, containing no bundled local storage disks, and operates with a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong computing performance, particularly in single-core and cryptographic scenarios. The server achieved a stress-ng single-core score of 3,070.88 and a Geekbench single-core score of 2,006.0, both ranking in the top 25%. Multi-core execution showed solid throughput, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 16,473.0 (top 25%) and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 175.59 GB/sec. The PassMark encryption benchmark registered 38,554.37, further emphasizing the efficacy of its onboard cryptographic instructions. Memory operations are equally robust, backed by a PassMark memory score of 2,858.75.

System-level operational benchmarks sit comfortably within the middle tier. The instance processed 43.48 million Redis SET operations per second and handled PassMark database operations at 15,837.04. Static web serving throughput reached 27.53 GB/sec, while gzip compression posted 28.98 GB/sec. These results represent standard throughput for balanced 32-vCPU configurations without indicating I/O or processing bottlenecks.

Because the ecs.g8a.8xlarge does not include integrated local NVMe storage or hardware GPUs, it trades raw low-latency disk access for deployment flexibility. This profile delivers a balanced cost-efficiency equation for enterprise applications that require steady CPU performance and substantial memory without paying for unused specialized acceleration hardware. It fits enterprise web serving, Redis caching clusters, application backends, and moderate relational database hosting.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8a.8xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance equipped with 32 vCPUs from an AMD EPYC 9T24 processor at 2.7 GHz and 128 GB of RAM. Operating under KVM virtualization, it provides a 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio, a 10 Gbps baseline network interface, and relies on network-attached storage with zero local disk bundled. The architecture incorporates AVX-512 extensions and hardware cryptographic acceleration, enabling top-tier performance in single-core tasks, memory benchmarks, and encryption workloads, as evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 2,006.0 and a PassMark memory score of 2,858.75. Mid-tier throughput across Redis SET operations (43.48 million ops/sec) and database benchmarks supports balanced compute scenarios. Without local NVMe drives or discrete GPUs, this instance provides predictable performance efficiency suited for enterprise web backends, caching services, and transactional databases.
